groups.label: Pick coins by
groups.caption: Score or quality, each with its own buy and sell rules

groups.label: When to buy
groups.caption: A coin must pass all of these

groups.label: Before buying
groups.caption: The chart is checked again with live data just before each buy

dials.label: Buy new coins
dials.help: Off pauses new buys. Open positions are still managed and sold.

dials.label: Pull the Radar every
dials.help: How often the bot fetches the Radar from the site.

dials.label: Fast feed
dials.help: Ask the tracker to send every 3 seconds while the bot runs, as it does when the Radar page is open. Uses more of the site's daily request allowance.

dials.label: Live prices for open positions
dials.help: Check open positions against DexScreener between pulls so stops react in seconds.

dials.label: Live price check every
dials.help: Only used while a position is open.

dials.label: Starting balance
dials.help: Used the next time the account is reset.

choices: Score: the Radar's live runner score
dials.label: Pick coins by
dials.help: The bot finds, buys and sells coins on this number, with the rules below for that mode. The other number is not required.

dials.label: Score mode: buy at a score of
dials.help: The Radar's 0 to 100 score.

choices: Not falling over the last minute
dials.label: Score mode: buy while the score is
dials.help: Read from the bot's own pulls over the last minute.

dials.label: Score mode: sell when the score falls below
dials.help: A disqualified coin scores 0, so this sells it. 0 turns this off.

dials.label: Score mode: sell when the score falls from its best
dials.help: Points below the best score seen since buying. 0 turns this off.

dials.label: Quality mode: buy at a quality score of
dials.help: Holder quality from the Pulse checklist. Coins with no quality score are skipped.

choices: Not falling over the last minute
dials.label: Quality mode: buy while quality is
dials.help: Read from the bot's own pulls over the last minute.

dials.label: Quality mode: sell when quality falls below
dials.help: 0 turns this off.

dials.label: Quality mode: sell when quality falls from its best
dials.help: Points below the best quality score seen since buying. 0 turns this off.

dials.label: Quality mode: sell when a check fails
dials.help: Sell when a checklist item that passed at the buy now fails, such as top 10, dev or bundlers.

dials.label: Radar signal required
dials.help: Which of the Radar's own picks the bot may buy.

dials.label: Maximum price gain, 5 minutes
dials.help: Skip coins that already ran this far. 0 means no limit.

dials.label: Minimum viewer growth
dials.help: Viewers gained per minute.

dials.label: Minimum liquidity
dials.help: Coins with no liquidity figure are skipped unless this is 0.

dials.label: Maximum market cap
dials.help: 0 means no limit.

dials.label: Minimum share of buys, 5 minutes
dials.help: Buys as a share of all trades.

dials.label: Maximum coin age
dials.help: 0 means no limit.

dials.label: Riskiest safety rating allowed
dials.help: The RugCheck rating on the Radar.

dials.label: Most failed quality checks
dials.help: Top 10, dev, snipers, insiders, bundlers, fees, dev record, holders, authorities.

dials.label: Skip coins with a Radar warning
dials.help: Liquidity pulled, a sharp dump, or risky authorities.

choices: Skip coins the Radar says to wait on or never rebuy
Skip only coins the Radar says never to rebuy
dials.label: Radar buy advice
dials.help: The Radar tests which warning signs came before falls and marks each coin ok, wait or never. Coins it says to exit or tighten are skipped too.

dials.label: Rebuy only above the old high
dials.help: After the bot sells a coin, buy it again only once the price is back above its high at the time of that sale.

dials.label: Oldest data to buy on
dials.help: No buys while the Radar or a coin's last reading is older than this.

dials.label: Pulls in a row before buying
dials.help: A coin must pass on this many pulls in a row, so a one-off flicker is ignored.

dials.label: Wait before buying the same coin again
Most buys of one coin in 24 hours
Check the chart before buying
dials.help: Just before a buy the bot pulls a live DexScreener price, volume, buys and liquidity, and checks the holder figures are fresh and the coin has not been dumped. A coin that fails is skipped.

dials.label: Skip if the price fell since the Radar reading
dials.help: Compares the live price with the price the Radar scored.

dials.label: Skip if it fell this far from its 10-minute high
dials.help: A coin this far under its high from the last 10 minutes has already been dumped. 0 turns this off.

dials.label: Skip if it dropped this much in 30 seconds
dials.help: Catches a dump that is happening right now. 0 turns this off.

dials.label: Holder figures no older than
dials.help: Top 10, dev, bundler and holder counts must have been read this recently. 0 turns this off.

dials.label: Skip while holders are falling
dials.help: More wallets selling out than buying in over the last minute.

dials.label: Recheck volume, buy share and liquidity live
dials.help: The live 5-minute volume, buy share and liquidity must still meet the When to buy limits.

dials.label: Minimum runner chance
dials.help: The learner's chance that this coin becomes a runner. 0 turns this off.

dials.label: Minimum could-explode chance
dials.help: From viewer bursts. 0 turns this off.

dials.label: Minimum big-winner chance
dials.help: From the coins that made the biggest gains. 0 turns this off.

choices: Buy at any point in a run
Skip coins past their usual crash time
Also skip coins near their usual crash time
dials.label: Crash timing
dials.help: Uses the learner's expected life for coins like this one.

dials.label: Minimum time left before the usual crash
dials.help: 0 turns this off.

dials.label: When a prediction is not ready
dials.help: Applies only to the learned rules turned on above.

dials.label: Risk strength
dials.help: Scales how much of the account can be in coins at once, and every buy when buys are a share of the account. 5 uses the numbers below as written, 10 doubles them, 1 uses a fifth.

choices: A fixed amount of SOL each time
A share of the account, scaled by risk strength
dials.label: How each buy is sized
Buy amount
dials.help: Used when buys are a fixed amount.

dials.label: Most SOL in one coin
dials.help: Across every buy of the same coin in 24 hours. 0 means no limit.

dials.label: Share of the account per buy
dials.help: Used when buys are a share of the account. At risk strength 5.

dials.label: Largest single buy
dials.help: A hard cap on any buy, whatever the buy amount or risk strength.

dials.label: Smallest buy worth making
dials.help: Smaller buys are skipped.

dials.label: Most of the account in coins
dials.help: At risk strength 5.

dials.label: Largest buy against a coin's liquidity
dials.help: Keeps buys small enough to get out of.

dials.label: Bet more on stronger setups
dials.help: Only when buys are a share of the account. Half size at the minimum score, up to one and a half times at a perfect score or learned chance.

dials.label: Daily loss limit
dials.help: No more buys today once the account is down this much. 0 turns this off.

dials.label: Drawdown stop
dials.help: No more buys while the account is this far below its high. 0 turns this off.

dials.label: Losses in a row before a break
dials.help: 0 turns this off.

dials.label: Most buys in an hour
dials.help: 0 means no limit.

dials.label: Stop loss
dials.help: Sell when the price is this far below the entry. 0 turns this off. The Radar's research found coins often bounce after a dip, so a tight stop sells too early.

dials.label: Profit target
dials.help: 0 turns this off.

dials.label: Share sold at the profit target
dials.help: The rest rides on the trailing stop.

dials.label: Protect the entry price after the target
dials.help: Once the target is hit, sell the rest if the price falls back to the entry.

dials.label: Trailing stop
dials.help: Sell when the price falls this far from its high since buying. 0 turns this off.

dials.label: Trailing stop starts after a gain of
Longest time to hold
dials.help: 0 means no limit.

dials.label: Sell a stalled trade after
dials.help: 0 turns this off.

dials.label: A trade is stalled below a gain of
Sell when viewers fall
dials.help: Measured from the most viewers seen since buying. 0 turns this off.

dials.label: Sell on a Radar warning
dials.help: Liquidity pulled, a sharp dump, or risky authorities.

dials.label: Sell when the Radar says exit
dials.help: The Radar marks a coin exit when it crashed, has a warning, or shows a sign that came before falls in its own history.

dials.label: When the Radar says momentum is fading
dials.help: The Radar's tighten advice. The bot never adds to a position either way.

dials.label: Trailing stop while tightened
dials.help: Used at once, whatever the gain, while the Radar says tighten or the coin has left the Radar.

dials.label: When a held coin leaves the Radar
dials.help: The tracker stopped seeing the volume, trades or liquidity it requires.

dials.label: Sell past the usual crash time
dials.help: Uses the learner's expected life for coins like this one.

dials.label: Sell after this long with no price
dials.help: Sold at the last known price.

dials.label: Trading fee
dials.help: Axiom's fee plus the pool's fee, on each buy and each sell.

choices: Auto fee: follow the network, up to the max fee
My own priority fee and bribe
dials.label: Network fees
dials.help: Paid on every buy and every sell, in SOL.

choices: Low: the cheapest that usually lands
High: lands first when it is busy
dials.label: Auto fee speed
dials.help: Auto fee is estimated from live Jito tip levels and Solana priority fees. Axiom does not publish its own formula, so this is a close stand-in, not a copy.

dials.label: Max fee
dials.help: The most auto fee pays in priority fee and bribe together.

dials.label: Priority fee
dials.help: Used when you set your own fees, and when auto fee has no live data.

dials.label: Bribe
dials.help: Used when you set your own fees, and when auto fee has no live data.

dials.label: Model price impact from liquidity
dials.help: Bigger bets in thinner pools get worse prices, and a pulled pool pays almost nothing.

dials.label: Extra slippage
dials.help: For delay and other traders, on top of price impact.

dials.label: Extra slippage on stop and exit sells
dials.help: These coins fall faster than prices arrive, so stops rarely sell where they are set. Applies to stop loss, trailing stop, Radar exit and warning sells.
